$comment: Source of truth for the PWA's real PNG icons. Binary files cannot be committed through the text-only push path this repo is developed with, so the exact PNG bytes live here as base64 and scripts/decode-icons.mjs materializes them into public/icons/ before every build (CI, Lovable deploys and local builds alike). The outputs are gitignored; this file is the only source of truth. src/lib/pwa-icons.test.ts pins every declaration below.
